title: Piron's Purple Rose of Cairo and Leclerc's second part
summary: Leclerc says he wrote the second part of Piron's Purple Rose of Cairo; they look at sheet music and find Jimmy Dupree wrote the words and Steve Lewis co-wrote it.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
